260600.title: Aluminium ores and concentrates (bauxite)
260600.boundary: The ore; Guinea/Australia/Indonesia lead. Indonesia banned raw exports to force domestic refining.

281820.title: Aluminium oxide (alumina), excl. corundum
281820.boundary: The refined intermediate (Bayer process); China and Australia lead.

760110.title: Aluminium, unwrought, not alloyed
760110.boundary: Primary metal as traded; routes through metal hubs, and captive/integrated smelter output may not appear.

760120.title: Aluminium, unwrought, alloyed
760120.boundary: Alloyed primary/secondary metal; mixes primary and recycled sources.
